Get genomic information

get_genomic_info.Rd

Retrieves genomic coordinates and chromosome arm annotations for a set of genes from Ensembl and combines them with chromosome size and centromere information.

The function returns gene level and chromosome level annotation tables that can be used for chromosome arm spatial copy number inference.

This function was used to generate the packaged datasets hg38_gene_info and hg38_chrom_info.

Usage

get_genomic_info(
  xenium.obj = NULL,
  genes = NULL,
  chrom_sizes_file = system.file("extdata", "hg38.chrom.sizes.txt", package =
    "SpatialCopyInference"),
  centromere_file = system.file("extdata", "centromeres_hg38.tsv", package =
    "SpatialCopyInference")
)

Arguments

xenium.obj

Xenium object containing genes to annotate.

genes

Character vector of HGNC gene symbols. Either xenium.obj or genes must be supplied.

chrom_sizes_file

Path to chromosome size file.

centromere_file

Path to centromere annotation file.

Value

A list containing gene and chromosome annotation information.
